body: Chief on the scale-selector checkpoint: APPROVED — closed CodexScale with exact target mapping (no coercion; window targets a later case), scale on CodexSpec/CodexContract, config checksum v2, non-feature annotations stay visible, feature annotations compiled through one SupportResolver and EvidenceVisibility.clipSupport into the normal coalesce/LaneAllocation path (no renderer-only lane), at-scale observationCount, Missing distinct from zero. On (5): your reading is correct — CodexContract.feature + the config checksum + per-annotation FeatureAddress.Space/Derivation audit addresses ARE the provenance; ViewProvenance grows no field. Three requirements: (a) the v2 config rendering is specified in ADR 0002 (field order, escaping) as a versioned canonical rendering — same rule as the receipt renderings in ADR 0001; (b) Derived(derivation, basisId: Option[Checksum]) as an interim slot is fine, but Some(basis) while unresolved must fail closed at compile with a typed unresolved state in FeatureChannelState (never silently behave as None); when cursor-grok-4.6's BasisId lands, the slot becomes Option[BasisId] and resolution goes through outputSpaceId(basis); (c) the textual twin prints scale AND the resolved space id. Scope as proposed; mote begin; candidate in a worktree, unstaged until ack.
